241: O beautiful Beloved who charms the mind, support of all beings,
ਗੁਰ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ; ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
I bow low again and again at the Guru's feet, asking him to show You to me. ॥3॥
ਮੈ ਕੀਏ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ; ਇਕਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
I made friends of many, but now I give myself to the One alone.
ਸਭ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੀਆ ॥੪॥
No one else holds all the virtues; the Lord alone has the full treasuries. ॥4॥
ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ; ਸੂਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Your Name is being repeated in all four directions, and whoever repeats it lives in comfort, his life set right.
ਮੈ ਆਹੀ ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੫॥
I have looked to Your support. O Nanak, say: I give myself up to You. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰਿ. ਕਾਢਿਓ ਭੁਜਾ ਪਸਾਰਿ; ਮੋਹ ਕੂਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
Stretching out his arm, the Guru has drawn me out of the well of attachment.
ਮੈ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਹਾਰੀਆ ॥੬॥
I have won the game of this precious human birth and will not lose it again. ॥6॥
ਮੈ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਾਰੀਆ ॥
I have found the Lord, treasure of all virtues, whose praises cannot be told.
Those who meet Him gain honour in His court and walk there swinging their arms. ॥7॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਲਧਾ ਰਤਨੁ; ਅਮੋਲੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ॥
O servant Nanak, those who hold to the Guru obtain the jewel of the Name, precious beyond measure.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ. ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੀਐ; ਕਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
I call out and say: by taking the Guru's refuge the world-ocean is crossed. ॥8॥12॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Dye your mind in the colour of love for the Lord.
ਜਪਿ ਜਿਹਵਾ; ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਮੰਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Repeat the Name with your tongue, and ask the Lord for His Name alone. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the knowledge the Guru gives, put away pride and remember the Lord.
One whose forehead bears the writ of grace from the beginning does this by joining the company of the holy. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ; ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਗਇਓ ॥
Nothing that is seen goes along with anyone,
yet the fool wrapped up in Maya clings to it, is ruined and dies a spiritual death. ॥2॥
The Name of the enchanting Lord, who is always present everywhere,
is found by some rare one among millions, through the Guru's refuge. ॥3॥
Bow again and again to the Lord's saints,
and you will find boundless happiness and the Name, which is like the nine treasures. ॥4॥
O holy people, may my eyes keep seeing those who repeat the Name.
Sing in your heart the Name, the treasure of all happiness. ॥5॥
Put away lust, anger, greed and attachment.
Whoever does so is freed from both birth and death. ॥6॥
Pain and darkness vanish from the home of the heart
of one in whom the Guru has fixed a deep bond with God; the lamp of insight is lit within. ॥7॥
Whoever has remembered the Lord has crossed over.
O servant Nanak, by taking the Guru's refuge the world crosses the ocean. ॥8॥1॥13॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ; ਭਰਮ ਗਏ ॥
Repeating the Lord's Name and calling on the Guru, all my mind's wanderings have gone,
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ; ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and my mind has obtained every comfort. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ ਤਉਕਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
The mind was burning and ablaze; when the sandalwood of the Guru's word was sprinkled on it, it grew cool. ॥1॥
ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
The darkness of ignorance went when the knowledge given by the Guru shone out. ॥2॥
ਪਾਵਕੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗਹਰੋ; ਚਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਨਾਵ. ਤਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
This deep world-ocean is all fire; boarding the boat of the company of the holy, I have crossed it. ॥3॥
ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਰਮ. ਨ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਚ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਆਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
I had no good deeds, no dharma, no purity; God took me by the arm and made me His own. ॥4॥
ਭਉ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਓ ॥੫॥
The Name of the Lord who loves devotion, which destroys fear and breaks sorrow, has come to me by His own grace. ॥5॥
ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ; ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਸੰਤ ਓਟਾਇਓ ॥੬॥
O Master of the masterless, merciful to the humble, all-powerful, support of the saints, ॥6॥
ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ; ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥੭॥
hear the prayer of one without virtue: O sovereign Lord, grant me the sight of You. ॥7॥
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇਓ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, say: O Master, I Your servant have come to Your refuge, to Your door. ॥8॥2॥14॥
242: ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਭੋਗਾ; ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
A person goes on merrily enjoying Maya's pleasures; blind and absorbed in them, he does not understand. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਸੰਚਉ ਹਉ ਖਾਟਤਾ; ਸਗਲੀ ਅਵਧ ਬਿਹਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
"I am gathering, I am earning": in such thoughts the whole of life passes. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਉ ਸੂਰਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਹਉ; ਕੋ. ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਝਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
I am a hero, I am the chief, no one is my equal. ॥2॥
ਜੋਬਨਵੰਤ ਅਚਾਰ ਕੁਲੀਨਾ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
I am handsome, of good conduct, of high family: so he grows proud in his mind. ॥3॥
ਜਿਉ ਉਲਝਾਇਓ ਬਾਧ ਬੁਧਿ; ਕਾ ਮਰਤਿਆ. ਨਹੀ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੀ ॥੪॥
As the man of deadened understanding stays entangled, so even when dying he does not forget Maya. ॥4॥
ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਸਖੇ; ਪਾਛੇ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਕਉ ਸੰਪਾਨੀ ॥੫॥
Brothers, friends, relatives and companions: after him it is to them that he hands it all over. ॥5॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੋ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ; ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਨੀ ॥੬॥
The desire to which the mind stays attached is the one that asserts itself at the end. ॥6॥
ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਸੁਚਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ; ਇਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੭॥
Doing deeds of ritual purity in pride, he stays bound in those very bonds. ॥7॥
ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੮॥੩॥੧੫॥੪੪॥ ਜੁਮਲਾ
O Nanak, say: merciful, all-pervading Lord, show me grace and keep me the servant of Your servants. ॥8॥3॥15॥44॥ (total)
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੁੰਧ ਰੈਣਿ ਦੁਹੇਲੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ; ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
The young bride's night passes in pain; sleep does not come to her.
ਸਾ ਧਨ. ਦੁਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ; ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਹਾਵੈ ॥
The wife grows weaker day by day, sighing for her husband.
ਧਨ ਥੀਈ ਦੁਬਲਿ. ਕੰਤ ਹਾਵੈ; ਕੇਵ. ਨੈਣੀ ਦੇਖਏ ॥
She wastes away sighing for her husband, longing somehow to see him with her eyes.
ਸੀਗਾਰ ਮਿਠ ਰਸ. ਭੋਗ ਭੋਜਨ; ਸਭੁ ਝੂਠੁ. ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖਏ ॥
Adornments, sweet tastes, pleasures and foods all seem insipid to her and of no account.
ਮੈ ਮਤ ਜੋਬਨਿ. ਗਰਬਿ ਗਾਲੀ; ਦੁਧਾ. ਥਣੀ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
One drunk on the wine of youth and wasted by pride never comes to the blessed state of a wife.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the soul-bride meets Him only when the Guru unites her; without the Husband she has no peace through life's night. ॥1॥
ਮੁੰਧ ਨਿਮਾਨੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਧਨੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Without her beloved Husband the young bride stays downcast.
ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
She cannot feel comfort unless He holds her to His breast.
ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨੁ. ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
Without the Husband there is no settled home; ask your friends and companions, they say the same.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ. ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
Without the Name His love and affection are not gained; those who join with the eternal Lord's Name live in comfort.
ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਜਨ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਮੇਲਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
She in whose mind the eternal Lord dwells, who lives in contentment, meets the Friend; through the Guru's teaching she knows her Husband to be near.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਸਾ ਧਨ; ਨਾਮਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀਆ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, that soul-bride never gives up the Name; joined to the Name she rests in spiritual poise. ॥2॥
ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ; ਹਮ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇਹਾ ॥
Come, friends and companions, let us sit together and worship our Husband-Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ. ਲਿਖਉਗੀ ਜੀਉ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
Taking the Guru's teaching, I will send Him my message through the Guru's word.
ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ; ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀਆ ॥
To her whom the Guru gave his word he showed the eternal Lord; those who follow their own minds are left regretting.
ਨਿਕਸਿ ਜਾਤਉ. ਰਹੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ; ਜਾਮਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
Once she recognises the eternal Lord, her mind that ran outward becomes still.
ਸਾਚ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ. ਸਦਾ ਨਉਤਨ; ਸਬਦਿ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਓ ॥
With the eternal Lord within, her understanding stays ever fresh, and through the word her love for Him is ever new.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਚਾ; ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, by His glance of grace the eternal Lord keeps her in spiritual poise; come, friends and companions, let us sit together and praise Him. ॥3॥
ਮੇਰੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜੀਉ; ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
My desire is fulfilled: the Friend has come to dwell in the home of my heart.
When the soul-bride meets her Husband, her senses sing a song of joy.
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲੁ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਹਸੀ; ਮੁੰਧ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਓ ॥
Singing the song of His praise she blossoms in love, and eagerness rises in her mind.
ਸਾਜਨ ਰਹੰਸੇ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਿਆਪੇ; ਸਾਚੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਓ ॥
Her good qualities flourish and the evil ones are subdued; repeating the eternal Name she gains the profit of unfailing spiritual life.
ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ. ਸਾ ਧਨ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਨਤੀ; ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਸਿ ਭਿੰਨੀਆ ॥
Steeped day and night in the taste of His love, the soul-bride prays with joined palms.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ; ਇਛ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
O Nanak, the Husband-Lord and the soul-bride rejoice together; my desire is fulfilled. ॥4॥1॥
243: ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜੀਉ; ਏਕਲੜੀ ਬਨ ਮਾਹੇ ॥
Listen, O Lord my Husband: I am alone in this wilderness of the world.
ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰੈਗੀ ਨਾਹ ਬਿਨਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
O carefree Lord, without You my Husband my soul cannot find composure.
ਧਨ. ਨਾਹ ਬਾਝਹੁ, ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ; ਬਿਖਮ ਰੈਣਿ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ॥
The soul-bride cannot live without her Husband; her night of life passes very hard.
ਨਹ ਨੀਦ ਆਵੈ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀਆ ॥
I find no peace; Your love is dear to me; hear my prayer.
ਬਾਝਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਾਰੇ; ਏਕਲੜੀ ਕੁਰਲਾਏ ॥
Without the Beloved no one asks after her; she cries out all alone.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the soul-bride meets Him only if the Guru unites her; without the Beloved she suffers pain. ॥1॥
She whom the Husband has forgotten, who else can unite her with Him?
ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਜੀਉ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
She who through the Guru's word is joined to the taste of His Name and love becomes beautiful within.
ਸਬਦੇ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ. ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ; ਦੀਪਕ ਦੇਹ ਉਜਾਰੈ ॥
When the word makes her beautiful she wins honour, and the lamp of knowledge lights up her body.
ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ. ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ; ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
Listen, my friend: she who keeps the eternal Lord's virtues in mind is at ease, joined to the Eternal.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ. ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਰਾਵੀ; ਬਿਗਸੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
When the true Guru joined her to his word, the Husband united her with Himself; through the life-giving bani her heart blossoms.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾ ਧਨ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ; ਜਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, the soul-bride meets her Husband only when she becomes pleasing to His mind. ॥2॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ. ਨੀਘਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ; ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
She whom enchanting Maya has charmed, cheated by love of perishable things, takes to trading in what perishes.
ਕਿਉ ਖੂਲੈ ਗਲ ਜੇਵੜੀਆ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
The noose round her neck cannot be loosed without the dearly loved Guru.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ. ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
One who loves the Lord and reflects on His virtues through the word becomes His own servant.
ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਨਾਵਣ; ਕਿਉ ਅੰਤਰ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
Many acts of charity and many holy baths cannot wash away the filth within.
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ. ਗਤਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਬੇਬਾਣੈ ॥
Without the Name no one reaches the high spiritual state, by forced restraint of the senses or by sitting in the forest.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ. ਮਹਲੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, the eternal Lord's court is recognised through the Guru's word; one who looks to another support cannot find it. ॥3॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ; ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
Your Name is eternal, O Lord; the word of Your praise is unfailing and reflection on Your virtues lasts.
ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਜੀਉ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ ॥
Your court is eternal, and the trade in Your Name is the trade that always stays with us.
ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ॥
The trade in the Name is sweet, and the profit of devotion grows day by day.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝੁ. ਵਖਰੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੋ ॥
No other merchandise but His Name gives such gain; repeat the Name at every moment.
ਪਰਖਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੀ; ਕਰਮਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
One who tests this account receives His unfailing glance of grace, and by His perfect grace obtains the Name.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
O Nanak, the Name is eternal and of very sweet taste; it is obtained through the perfect Guru. ॥4॥2॥
Gauri Purbi · Chhant · Guru Amar Das
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਸਾ ਧਨ. ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
The soul-bride makes her prayer and holds the Lord's virtues in her heart.
ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ. ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Without her beloved Lord she cannot rest for a moment, for an instant.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ. ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Without her beloved Lord she cannot rest; yet His dwelling is not found without the Guru.
ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ. ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਕੀਜੈ; ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥
If what the Guru says is fully carried out, the fire of craving is put out.
ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
The Lord alone is eternal, and apart from Him there is no lasting companion; without taking His refuge she finds no comfort.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, only that soul-bride whom He Himself unites meets Him, united through the Guru. ॥1॥
ਧਨ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੀਉ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
The night of life passes easily for the soul-bride who keeps her mind joined to the Lord;
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
she takes the true Guru's refuge, loves him, and removes the self from within.
ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਓ ॥
Removing the self from within and singing the Lord's praises, she keeps her love for Him at all times.
ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਮੇਲੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਓ ॥
Hearing the Guru's word from like-hearted friends and companions, she stays absorbed in it.
244: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੀ. ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ; ਨਾਮੇ ਧਰੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
She who holds the Lord's virtues in her heart and gives her love to the Name becomes dear to her Husband.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, the woman who wears the Lord's Name as a garland round her neck is dear to her Husband. ॥2॥
ਧਨ ਏਕਲੜੀ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
The soul-bride who is alone, without her beloved Husband,
ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮੁਠੀ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
is being cheated by love of other things, without the Guru's sustaining word.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਆਰੇ. ਕਉਣੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
Without the beloved word, who can carry her across the hard ocean? She is being ruined by attachment to Maya.
ਕੂੜਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ. ਤਾ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੁਤੀ; ਸਾ ਧਨ. ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
When she is ruined by falsehood, she has been deserted by her Husband; that soul-bride cannot find His dwelling.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੇ ਰਾਤੀ. ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
But she who is dyed in the Guru's word is absorbed in spiritual poise and stays merged in Him day and night.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, that woman is always dyed in His love; the Lord Himself keeps her united with Him. ॥3॥
ਤਾ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਵਣੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
We meet Him only if the Lord Himself unites us; who but the Lord can unite us?
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੀਉ; ਕਉਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
Without our beloved Guru, who can remove the mind's wandering?
ਗੁਰੁ. ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ, ਇਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਾਏ; ਤਾ. ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
When the Guru removes the wandering, O mother, that is how He is met, and then the soul-bride finds bliss.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ. ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
Without taking the Guru's refuge there is pitch darkness; without the Guru the way is not found.
ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ, ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
She who reflects through the Guru's word stays dyed in His love and absorbed in spiritual poise.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
O Nanak, by abiding in love for the Guru the woman finds the Lord as her Husband. ॥4॥1॥
ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
Without my Husband my soul is utterly destitute; without Him, O my mother, no spiritual life can come to me.
ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ; ਕਾਪੜੁ. ਤਨਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
Without my Husband I have no peace, and no clothing pleases me on my body.
ਕਾਪਰੁ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ. ਜਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
Clothing pleases on the body only when I please my Husband; the mind joins to Him only by following the Guru's teaching.
ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ. ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
She is fortunate for ever when she takes the true Guru's refuge; one should stay settled in the Guru's lap.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਾ. ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੀ; ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
When my mind joins to the Guru's word I meet my Husband; the Name is the real earning in the world.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the woman becomes dear to her Husband when she keeps the Lord's virtues in her heart. ॥1॥
ਸਾ ਧਨ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਜੀਉ; ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
The soul-bride enjoys bliss in union with her own Beloved;
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਜੀਉ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
day and night she is dyed in His love, reflecting on the Guru's word.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Reflecting on the Guru's word she kills her pride; meet the Beloved in this way.
ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ. ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
That soul-bride is fortunate, always dyed in His love, who loves the eternal Lord's Name.
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗਹੀਐ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Stay joined to your Guru, from whom the life-giving water of the Name is received; she who receives it drives out all sense of mine and yours.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, that woman has gained the Lord as her Husband and forgotten all her sorrows. ॥2॥
ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਭੁਲੀ ਜੀਉ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
The woman who strays from the memory of her Husband comes to love other things, caught in attachment to Maya.
ਝੂਠੀ. ਝੂਠਿ ਲਗੀ ਜੀਉ; ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
A trader in false, perishable things, she stays attached to false love and is cheated by it.
ਕੂੜੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ. ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੇ; ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ. ਨ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
But she who keeps the Guru's teaching in her heart removes that falsehood and does not waste her birth.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
She holds on to the Guru's word, merges in the eternal Lord and kills the pride within.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ; ਐਸਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
She settles the Lord's Name in her heart; such is the adornment she makes.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, the woman whose support in life is the eternal Lord's Name stays in spiritual poise. ॥3॥
ਮਿਲੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਜੀਉ; ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਖਰੀ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ॥
Meet me, O my Beloved; without You I am utterly helpless.
ਮੈ ਨੈਣੀ. ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜੀਉ; ਭਾਵੈ. ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Sleep does not come to my eyes, and neither food nor water pleases me.
ਪਾਣੀ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ. ਮਰੀਐ ਹਾਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Food and water do not please, the soul suffers in sighing; without the Husband no bliss is found.
245: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ. ਕਰਉ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ, ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ; ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤਿਵੈ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
I pray before the Guru: O Guru, if my prayer pleases you, unite me with Him in whatever way it can be done.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
The Giver of all comforts Himself unites; He Himself comes into that heart's home and meets her.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ; ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥
O Nanak, that soul-bride is fortunate for ever, for her Husband neither dies nor parts from her. ॥4॥2॥
ਕਾਮਣਿ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਬੇਧੀ ਜੀਉ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
Fortunate is the soul-bride whose mind stays pierced by the taste of God's Name, who stays settled in God's love and in steadiness,
ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
and whose mind the beautiful Lord has captivated; her sense of mine and yours ends in inner steadiness.
ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
With that sense ended in steadiness she meets her Husband-Lord, and following the Guru's teaching she enjoys spiritual delight.
ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ. ਕੂੜਿ ਕੁਸਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ; ਗਲ ਤਾਈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
This body stays filled to the brim with falsehood and deceit, and the person goes on committing sins,
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ. ਜਿਤੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
but in the Guru's refuge he takes to devotion, from which a current of inner steadiness rises; without devotion the filth does not go.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the soul-bride who removes self-conceit from within becomes dear to her Husband-Lord. ॥1॥
ਕਾਮਣਿ. ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
The soul-bride who stays in the Guru's love meets her Husband-Lord.
ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੁਤੀ ਜੀਉ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
She settles Him within her heart and passes the night of her whole life in peace.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ. ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
Keeping Him in her heart she is united with her Beloved, and ends the pain of separation for good.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ. ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
The soul-bride who finds the Lord's dwelling within and, taking the Guru's teaching, reflects on His virtues, enjoys the bliss of union with her Husband.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੀਆ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
She who has drunk the life-giving Name day and night kills off the sense of mine and yours within her.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, through the Guru's boundless love that soul-bride stays united with the eternal Husband-Lord and becomes fortunate. ॥2॥
ਆਵਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
O dearly loved Beloved, in Your mercy come and dwell in my heart.
ਕਾਮਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰੇ ਜੀਉ; ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ॥
Fortunate is the soul-bride who makes this prayer, having made her inner life beautiful with the eternal Lord's Name and the Guru's word.
ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
She who so adorns her life with the eternal Name and the Guru's word drives out pride from within, and in the Guru's refuge sets all her affairs right,
ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
and by the reflection the Guru gives she comes to know the One who alone endures in every age.
ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੀ. ਮੋਹਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੀ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਇ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ॥
But the soul-bride who follows her own mind stays crushed by lust and suffers in attachment; before whom can she go and cry out?
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਮੁਖਿ, ਥਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, without the dearly loved Guru, she who follows her own mind finds no place. ॥3॥
ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਭੋਲੀ ਨਿਗੁਣੀਆ ਜੀਉ; ਪਿਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
The soul-bride is foolish, childish, guileless and without merit, while her Husband-Lord is unreachable and boundless.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਜੀਉ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
Union comes only if He Himself unites her; He Himself is the one who forgives.
ਅਵਗਣ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰਾ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
The beloved Husband-Lord is able to forgive the soul-bride's faults, and He dwells in every body.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ. ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
The true Guru has given this understanding: He is found through love and affection, through loving devotion.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
She who follows it stays in bliss day and night, her attention fixed on Him at every moment,
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
O Nanak, settled in steadiness she meets her Husband-Lord; that soul-bride has, as it were, gained the nine treasures. ॥4॥3॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਸਰੁ. ਸਬਲੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀਉ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ. ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
The surging lake of Maya exerts its force; it is hard to cross, so how is one to get across it?
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ. ਜੀਉ; ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
Make God's Name the ship, and seat the Guru's word in it as the boatman.
ਸਬਦੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਏ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਘਾਏ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
If a person seats the Guru's word in it as boatman, God Himself takes him across; this is how the hard crossing is made.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
In the Guru's refuge devotion to God is obtained, and so, while still going about the world's work, one becomes untouched by Maya.
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ; ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
Through God's Name sins are cut away in an instant, and the body becomes pure.
ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ; ਕੰਚਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰਾ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, it is through God's Name that one crosses over, and the mind, as useless as iron rust, turns to gold. ॥1॥
246: ਇਸਤਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਜੀਉ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
Women and men stay caught in lust and do not learn the way of remembering God's Name.
ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈ. ਖਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ; ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ. ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
Mother, father, sons and brothers are what they hold most dear; they drown in a lake that holds no water and die a spiritual death.
ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ. ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ, ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਧਾਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
Drowned without water they die that death and never examine their own spiritual state; the restlessness of pride grips the world.
ਜੋ ਆਇਆ. ਸੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਾਸੀ; ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
Whoever comes into the world gets caught in it; those escape who hold the Guru's word in their thoughts.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ; ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
One who turns to the Guru and utters God's Name crosses over himself and takes his family lines across too.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, one in whose heart the Name comes to dwell meets the beloved Lord by leaning on the Guru's teaching. ॥2॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ; ਬਾਜੀ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
This world is a game, and in it nothing but God's Name lasts.
ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਜੀਉ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
Fix devotion to God firmly within you, for it endures; trade in God's Name alone endures.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Trade in the Name of the unreachable, boundless God is the lasting wealth, and it is found by following the Guru's teaching.
ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
Serving God in devotion and fixing the attention on Him: this is the lasting capital, and by it self-conceit is driven out from within.
ਹਮ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਣ. ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅੰਧੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
We were without sense, foolish, dull and blinded by Maya; the true Guru has set us on the right path of life.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, those who turn to the Guru grow beautiful in life through his word, and sing God's praises all the time. ॥3॥
ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ. ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ; ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
God Himself causes things to be done and Himself does them; He Himself joins beings to the Guru's word and makes their lives beautiful.
ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਆਪਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਜੀਉ; ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
He Himself brings one to the true Guru, He Himself grants the word, and in every age He loves His devotees.
ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਭਗਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ; ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
In every age God loves His devotees; He Himself sets their lives right and Himself joins them to devotion.
ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ. ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ; ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
He Himself knows every heart and sees into it; He Himself has His service done.
ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ. ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾਟੇ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
He Himself grants virtues, removes faults, and makes His Name dwell in the heart.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਚੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
O Nanak, I am for ever a sacrifice to that eternal God, who Himself does all and Himself causes all to be done. ॥4॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ. ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
O dear soul, serve the Guru and meditate on God's Name,
ਮੰਞਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ. ਨ ਜਾਹਿ, ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ; ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
and you will not wander far from your own self, dear soul; God is found by staying in the home of the heart.
ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ; ਸਦਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ, ਸਹਜੇ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
One who, settled in steadiness and joined in love to the eternal Lord, keeps his mind always fixed on Him, finds God while staying in the heart's home.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
The service the Guru teaches brings great peace, but only he does it whom God Himself moves to it.
ਨਾਮੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਜੰਮੈ; ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
He sows only the Name, only the Name sprouts there, and he keeps only the Name dwelling in his mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, joined to the eternal Lord and His Name a person gains honour, and the record of his earlier good deeds comes to light within him. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ. ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ; ਜਾ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
God's Name is sweet, dear soul, as you will know when you taste it with your mind fixed on it.
ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ, ਮੁਯੇ ਜੀਉ; ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
O my luckless tongue, taste the savour of God's Name and give up the relish of all other tastes.
ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਏ. ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ; ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
When it pleases God, the tongue enjoys the taste of His Name always and grows beautiful through the Guru's word.
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ. ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
One who meditates on the Name and keeps his attention fixed in it enjoys bliss always,
ਨਾਮੇ ਉਪਜੈ. ਨਾਮੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਨਾਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
through the Name the longing for it arises in him, through the Name the pull of other tastes dies away, and through the Name he stays absorbed in the eternal Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਲਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, the Name is found by following the Guru's teaching, and God Himself creates the attachment to it. ॥2॥
ਏਹ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ. ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ; ਧਨ ਛੋਡਿ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
Dear soul, fawning on others is as painful as the hired work for which a man leaves his wife and goes abroad; the soul leaves its own inner home and wanders outside.
ਦੂਜੈ. ਕਿਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ, ਨ ਪਾਇਓ, ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ ॥
Caught in love of Maya no one has ever found peace, dear soul; a person becomes snared in greed for Maya.
ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਾਏ. ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ; ਓਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Snared in greed for Maya and led astray by wandering, how can he find peace?
ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਖਰੀ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ; ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਿ. ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
This fawning on others is very painful; a person sells his spiritual life and abandons his duty.
247: ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧਨ. ਟਿਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਏ ॥
Bound by Maya the mind does not stay still, and pain torments it at every moment.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ. ਤਦੇ ਚੂਕੈ; ਜਾ. ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, the pain that comes of Maya ends only when a person fixes his mind on the Guru's word. ॥3॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ, ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ; ਸਬਦੁ. ਮਨਿ ਨ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Dear soul, one who follows his own mind stays foolish and uncouth; he does not settle the Guru's word in his mind.
ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੁ. ਪਿਰਾ ਜੀਉ; ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
The whirl of Maya blinds him, dear soul, so how is he to find the way to God?
ਕਿਉ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਏ. ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਏ ॥
Without walking as the true Guru wills the way cannot be found, for one who follows his own mind always makes himself out to be great.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
God's servants, their minds fixed on the Guru's feet, are always at ease.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ. ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
Only he on whom God Himself has mercy sings God's praises always.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਗਿ ਲਾਹਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
O Nanak, the jewel of the Name is the real profit in the world; God Himself gives this understanding by bringing one to the Guru's refuge. ॥4॥5॥7॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
O Giver, my mind has grown restless; how am I to see You?
ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ॥
O my friend and companion, O God, greatest of all, all-pervading, the Creator!
ਪੁਰਖੋ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰੁ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਹ ਤੁਝੈ. ਉਡੀਣੀਆ ॥
You are all-pervading, the Creator, You alone the Lord of Lakshmi; parted from You we are distraught, so how are we to meet You?
ਕਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ, ਸੀਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ; ਮਨਿ ਆਸ ਦਰਸ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਆ ॥
Those who lay pride aside and serve with their hands, lay their heads at the Guru's feet and hold in their minds the hope of seeing Him,
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ. ਨ ਘੜੀ ਵਿਸਰੈ; ਪਲੁ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
do not forget Him with any breath, not for an hour, a moment or an instant, day or night.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਆਸੇ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, we thirst like the rainbird; O giving Lord, how are we to meet You? ॥1॥
ਇਕ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਜੀਉ; ਸੁਣਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Listen, my dear Husband, I make one prayer.
ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ; ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
Your wondrous shows, as I watched them, captured my mind and my body.
ਚਲਤਾ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ; ਉਦਾਸ ਧਨ. ਕਿਉ ਧੀਰਏ ॥
Watching Your shows I was beguiled; now this soul-bride has turned from them and finds no calm without You.
ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਨਾਹ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਬਾਲਾ; ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਪੂਰਏ ॥
O Husband, master of all virtues, You are merciful, ever young, and full of every virtue.
ਪਿਰ ਦੋਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ. ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਤੇ; ਹਉ ਵਿਛੁੜੀ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੇ ॥
The fault is not Yours, Husband, giver of all comforts; I, the wrongdoer, am separated from You by my own doing.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ; ਘਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ. ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, the soul-bride prays: dear Husband, have mercy and come to dwell in the home of her heart. ॥2॥
ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ. ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ; ਅਰਪੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
I would offer my mind, offer my whole body, and offer all my lands, the senses,
ਹਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਅਰਪੀ. ਤਿਸੁ ਮੀਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਇ ਸਦੇਸਾ ॥
I would offer my head to that dear friend who brings me the message that unites me with God.
ਅਰਪਿਆ ਤ ਸੀਸੁ. ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ; ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
She who, in the company of the holy, gave her head over to the Guru was shown by him God dwelling in her very heart;
ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ; ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
in an instant all her pain was gone, and she gained what her mind desired.
ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਕਰੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਮਿਟੇ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
That soul-bride enjoys spiritual bliss day and night, and all her worries are wiped away.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਕੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਲੋੜਤੇ ਹਮ ਜੈਸਾ ॥੩॥
Nanak prays: she finds the Husband-Lord, the very one that all of us keep seeking. ॥3॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੀਉ; ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ॥
My mind is filled with joy and my heart swings in gladness,
ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਸਭ ਤਿਖਾ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
for my dear Beloved has come into the home of my heart and all my craving is quenched.
ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤ ਲਾਲੁ. ਗੁਪਾਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸਖੀ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Since the dear Beloved, the Master who sustains the earth, met me, my companions, the senses, have begun a song of joy.
ਸਭ ਮੀਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਖੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ; ਦੂਤ ਥਾਉ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
All these friends and relations are filled with delight, and no trace remains of the enemies, lust and the rest.
ਅਨਹਤ ਵਾਜੇ. ਵਜਹਿ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ; ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ॥
Music plays unplayed within my heart, for I have spread my bed beside my Husband-Lord.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak prays: she who meets her Husband-God, giver of all comforts, stays settled in steadiness. ॥4॥1॥
248: ਮੋਹਨ. ਤੇਰੇ ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ; ਮਹਲ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
O Enchanter of the mind, Your temples are lofty and Your mansions have no far edge in sight.
ਮੋਹਨ. ਤੇਰੇ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦੁਆਰ ਜੀਉ; ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲਾ ॥
O Enchanter, at Your door, in Your houses of faith, Your saints look beautiful.
ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਅਪਾਰ, ਦੈਆਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
O boundless, merciful Master, in Your houses of faith they sing Your praises always.
ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ; ਤਹਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
Wherever the holy and the saints gather, there they meditate on You alone.
ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹੋਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰਾ ॥
O merciful Master, in Your kindness and compassion You are gracious to the poor.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
Nanak prays: those thirsting for the sight of You meet You and enjoy the joy of that sight. ॥1॥
ਮੋਹਨ. ਤੇਰੇ ਬਚਨ ਅਨੂਪ; ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥
O Enchanter, the words of Your praise are beautiful, and Your way is unlike that of any other.
ਮੋਹਨ. ਤੂੰ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਜੀ; ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਰਾਲੀ ॥
O Enchanter, it is You alone that all accept as lasting; all the rest of creation is perishable.
ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤ ਏਕੁ. ਅਲੇਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਜਿਨਹਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
They accept You alone, the indescribable Master, who has set Your power at work through all creation.
ਤੁਧੁ ਬਚਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ; ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥
Your devotees have won You over by the Guru's word; You are the origin of all, all-pervading, master of the world.
ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਿਆ. ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਆਪਿ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀਆ ॥
Present in all beings, it is You who depart, yet You Yourself remain for ever; You Yourself have set Your power at work in the world.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਸਭ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
Nanak prays: You Yourself keep the honour of Your servants, who all come to Your refuge. ॥2॥
ਮੋਹਨ. ਤੁਧੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ; ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
O Enchanter, the company of the holy meditates on You and fixes its mind on the sight of You.
ਮੋਹਨ. ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ, ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਤੁਧੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥
O Enchanter, the dread of death does not come near, at the last moment, those who repeat Your Name.
ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਜੋ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
The dread of death cannot touch those who meditate on You with a single mind.
ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਕਰਮਿ. ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ; ਸੇ ਸਭੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
Those who remember You in thought, word and deed obtain all the fruits.
ਮਲ ਮੂਤ ਮੂੜ. ਜਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਹੋਤੇ; ਸਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
Even people filthy in conduct and utterly foolish gain high understanding on seeing You.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਜੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ; ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Nanak prays: Your rule is unshakeable, O all-pervading, perfect Lord. ॥3॥
ਮੋਹਨ. ਤੂੰ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਿਆ; ਸਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ ॥
O Enchanter, You have flowered and borne fruit beautifully, and Yours is a great family.
ਮੋਹਨ. ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਭਾਈ ਕੁਟੰਬ; ਸਭਿ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
O Enchanter, whole households with their sons, friends and brothers You carry across, every one.
ਤਾਰਿਆ ਜਹਾਨੁ. ਲਹਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ; ਜਿਨੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
You are able to carry the whole world across, and from those who see You, You remove pride.
ਜਿਨੀ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਹਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
Those who praise You, spiritual death does not come near.
ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ. ਕਥੇ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
Your virtues are endless and cannot be told, O greatest of all, all-pervading Lord.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਟੇਕ ਰਾਖੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Nanak prays: I have taken Your support, and holding to it I am crossing the world-ocean. ॥4॥2॥
ਪਤਿਤ ਅਸੰਖ. ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰਿ; ਪੁਨਹ ਪੁਨਹ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
The Name makes countless sinners pure; be a sacrifice to it again and again.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ, ਪਾਵਕੋ; ਤਿਨ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਾਹਨਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, repeat God's Name: as fire burns straw, it has the power to burn away sins. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਤੂੰ. ਰਾਮ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
O my mind, repeat the Name of Ram, Narayan, Gobind, Hari, Madho.
ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨਾ. ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ; ਕਟੀਐ ਕਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਫਾਧੋ ॥
O my mind, adore Mukand, Murari; by this the noose of death and pain is cut.
ਦੁਖਹਰਣ ਦੀਨ ਸਰਣ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ॥
One should adore the lovely feet of the One who destroys pain, shelters the poor and is the support of Lakshmi.
ਜਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ. ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥
The hard road of death and the ocean of fire are made fair by remembering the Name even for an instant.
ਕਲਿਮਲਹ ਦਹਤਾ. ਸੁਧੁ ਕਰਤਾ; ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਅਰਾਧੋ ॥
Day and night remember that Name, which burns away sins and makes one pure.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਾਧੋ ॥੧॥
Nanak prays: O Gopal, Gobind, Madho, show me mercy. ॥1॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ. ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੁਖਹਰੁ; ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
O my mind, remember Damodar, the sovereign Lord, who removes pain and destroys fears,
ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੋ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਨੋਹਰੁ; ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥
who is the Husband of Lakshmi, the source of mercy, the captivator of the mind, and whose nature from the very first is to love devotion.
249: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ; ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
The perfect Being loves devotion; with His Name settled in the mind, every purpose the mind holds is attained.
ਤਮ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਾਰੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
If we settle the Name in the mind, it lifts us out of the darkness of the blind well of attachment to Maya.
ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ. ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ; ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
Gods, adepts, Shiva's attendants, heavenly musicians, sages and countless devotees have gone on singing His praises.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
Nanak prays: O supreme God, sovereign Lord, show me mercy. ॥2॥
ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨਾ. ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
O my mind, keep in remembrance the supreme God, who has set His power in all,
ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
who is compassion itself, all-powerful, the Master, and the support of life in every body,
ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ; ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
who gives breath, mind, body and life, and is endless, unreachable and boundless,
ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ; ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੋ ॥
who is able to help those who seek His refuge, all-powerful, beautiful, the destroyer of all evils.
ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ; ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
All illness, sorrow and faults vanish as one repeats the Name of Murari.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਸਮਰਥ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Nanak prays: O all-powerful One who has set Your power in all, show me mercy. ॥3॥
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ. ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
O my mind, sing the praises of the One who never falls and never perishes, who is highest of all and the home of mercy,
ਬਿਸੰਭਰੁ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ਏਕੈ; ਸਰਬ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
who sustains the whole world, who alone is able to give everything, and who cares for all.
ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਾਨਾ; ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਸੈ ॥
He cares for all, greatly merciful and knowing every heart; He shows mercy to every being.
ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਾਸੈ; ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥
From the one in whose heart God comes to dwell, attachment, greed and the thorn-like dread of death depart.
ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਦੇਵਾ. ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ; ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥
When God is well pleased with someone, his service bears fruit and his labour comes to completion.
ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ; ਜਪਤ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Nanak prays: every wish is fulfilled by repeating the Name of the One who is merciful to the poor. ॥4॥3॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ. ਮਿਲਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ; ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੈ ॥
Listen, my friend: come, let us together worship and win the favour of our Husband-Lord.
ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ. ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ; ਮੋਹਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੰਤੈ ॥
Putting away pride and making devotion the herb that beguiles, let us captivate Him by the Guru's teaching.
ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ. ਫਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ, ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਇਹ ਰੀਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ॥
Friend, this is the fine custom of God: once won over by love, He never leaves again.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ, ਭੈ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, He makes that being pure, and keeps old age, death, all fears and hell away from him. ॥1॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ. ਇਹ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ; ਏਹੁ ਮਤਾਂਤੁ ਪਕਾਈਐ ॥
Listen, my friend, to this good request: let us settle on this resolve,
ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ. ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ; ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
that, settled in steadiness and in love, and rid of deceit, we sing songs of Gobind's praise.
ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Inner strife and troubles are wiped out, the mind's chasings end, and the fruit the mind hopes for is obtained.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, one should meditate on the Name of the supreme, perfect God. ॥2॥
ਸਖੀ ਇਛ ਕਰੀ, ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਾਈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
Friend, I keep longing and making vows: O God, fulfil my hope,
ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ; ਪੇਖਉ ਥਾਨ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
thirsting for Your feet and impatient for the sight of You, I go looking in every place.
ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗੁ; ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Searching, I find the company of God's saints, which brings one to the all-powerful, all-pervading Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਰਿਜਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, those alone meet the Master of the gods' realm, giver of all comforts; they are the fortunate ones, O mother. ॥3॥
ਸਖੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਸਾ, ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
Friend, I now live with my dear Husband; my mind has grown used to God and my body is one with Him.
ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਨੀਦ ਭਲੀ; ਮੈ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
Listen, friend: even sleep is dear to me now, for in it too I meet my own beloved Husband.
ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ, ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ; ਕਉਲੁ ਖਿਲਿਆ ॥
The Master has removed my wandering; peace and steadiness stay within me, light has dawned, and my heart has opened like a lotus.
ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
O Nanak, I have found my Husband, the Lord who knows all hearts, and this married fortune never passes away. ॥4॥4॥2॥5॥11॥
250: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮਾਤਾ. ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਾ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰਾ ॥
The Guru is mother, the Guru is father, the Guru is the very form of the Master, God.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਖਾ. ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਸਹੋਦਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the friend who destroys the darkness of ignorance; the Guru is kinsman and brother.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਾਤਾ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੈ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ. ਨਿਰੋਧਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the real giver, who teaches God's Name; the Guru's teaching is one whose effect nothing can undo.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ. ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਪਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the embodiment of peace, truth and wisdom; the Guru is a philosopher's stone whose touch is better than that stone's own.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the place of pilgrimage, the pool of nectar; bathing in the Guru's wisdom surpasses every other bathing.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕਰਤਾ. ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਹਰਤਾ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ. ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵਿਤ ਕਰਾ ॥
The Guru is the form of the Creator and the remover of all sins; the Guru makes the fallen pure.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ. ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਾ ॥
From the very beginning, in every age, the Guru has been there; by repeating the Lord's Name that the Guru gives, one crosses over.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਪਾਪੀ. ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
O God, be merciful and give us the Guru's company, so that we foolish sinners may swim across in it.
ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਰਾ ॥੧॥
The Guru is the form of the supreme God; O Nanak, one should always bow to the Guru, who is the Lord's own form. ॥1॥
ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਾਇਆ; ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
God Himself has made all of creation, and He Himself has the power to do it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਦੂਸਰ. ਹੋਆ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, He alone pervades the whole world; there is no second beside Him. ॥1॥
We bow to the Formless One, who Himself takes on the form of the Guru,
who was Himself there at the world's beginning, is here now, and remains at its end.
When there is no world He is Himself the sheer aloneness, Himself resting in His own blissful being,
and then it is He Himself who listens to His own praise.
He Himself brings His own self into visible form;
He is His own father and His own mother.
He Himself is the unseen, and He Himself the seen.
O Nanak, this play of His cannot be described. ॥1॥
O God, kind to the humble, show me Your mercy,
ਤੇਰੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ; ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that my mind may stay as the dust of the feet of Your saints. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਆਪਿ; ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਏਕ ॥
The Formless One Himself makes the forms; He Himself stays beyond Maya's three qualities and, creating the world, takes them on.
ਏਕਹਿ ਏਕ ਬਖਾਨਨੋ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, out of His one form He makes the many, yet all that can be said is that He alone is. ॥1॥
God made the creation so that beings might become followers of the Guru.
He is able to keep them all strung on the single thread of His command.
He has spread out Maya's three qualities, each distinct.
From His unseen form He has made the world that is seen.
O God, You have brought forth the creation in kinds of every sort.
The attachment of the mind, root of birth and death, You too have made to grow,
yet You Yourself stand apart from birth and death.
O Nanak, neither His near shore nor His far shore can be found. ॥2॥
ਸੇਈ ਸਾਹ. ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੇ; ਸਚੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
They alone are bankers, they alone are rich, who hold the wealth of God's Name as their capital.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚੁ ਸੁਚਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਤਿਹ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the wealth of the Name and purity of spirit are gained from saints such as these. ॥1॥
That God is everlasting, everlasting, ever everlasting;
ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਤੇ; ਭਿੰਨ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
no one has any existence apart from that everlasting, all-pervading Being.
Only the one whom God Himself brings to His refuge comes into it.
Such a person remembers God, sings His praises, and lets others hear them too.
No dread and no wandering of mind can press upon him,
for he sees God's own glory plainly in every place.
Know as a holy man the one who reaches this state.
O Nanak, I give myself up to him for ever. ॥3॥
ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਪੁਕਾਰਤੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਕੂਰ ॥
Why do you go on crying out for wealth, wealth? Attachment to Maya is wholly false.
